name: apiforge-ai
description: APIForge AI - a lightweight, AI-assisted API testing and development platform

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/frontend
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run dev -w apps/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run dist:mac -w apps/desktop
